LanguageData.LP_GithSkin.label: gith skin
LanguageData.LP_GithSkin.description: The grey-yellow-green skin unique to the gith bloodline, like parchment long out of the sun.
LanguageData.LP_GithAstralStep.label: astral jump
LanguageData.LP_GithAstralStep.description: Githyanki can briefly step into the Astral Plane and walk out somewhere else within 8 cells. Githyanki with a psylink spend 5% psyfocus each time; without a psylink it's limited only by cooldown. Cooldown 12 hours.
LanguageData.LP_GithLichDevotee.label: devotee of the lich-queen
LanguageData.LP_GithLichDevotee.description: Githyanki have served the undying lich-queen for generations. When the colony has a lich, githyanki get mood +3; when a lich personally persuades githyanki prisoners, each talk lowers resistance 30% more.
LanguageData.LP_GithLichDevotee.customEffectDescripti: A lich of this colony on the same map: mood +3.
A lich as warden persuading: resistance reduced per talk ×130%.
LanguageData.LP_GithNemesis.label: favored enemy
LanguageData.LP_GithNemesis.description: The githyanki's ancestors were slaves of the mind flayers, and the hatred is carved into their bloodline. +25% damage against mind flayers, +10% melee hit chance; mind resistance +30%, and mind flayer tadpoles in the brain transform half as fast.
Against mind flayers: damage ×125%, melee hit chance +10%.
Mind flayer tadpole transformation speed ×50% (multiplies with the slowdown from mind resistance).
